description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolResultTextFormatter, verifying its handling of plain text, JSON summaries, error messages, and unknown payloads.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: A suite of tests for verifying the behavior of the ToolResultTextFormatter class.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Test that plain text input remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Test that JSON containing nodes list is summarized correctly.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Test that error JSON is summarized correctly and agent prefix is dropped.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Test that unknown JSON payloads produce empty output.
